tasks.label: OAF Website: Start DEVELOPMENT
args: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $taskMutex = New-Object System.Threading.Mutex($false, 'Local\OAF.Website.Development.5055'); $taskOwnsMutex = $false; try { try { $taskOwnsMutex = $taskMutex.WaitOne(0) } catch [System.Threading.AbandonedMutexException] { $taskOwnsMutex = $true }; if (-not $taskOwnsMutex) { Write-Host 'DEVELOPMENT launch is already active; existing server left running.'; exit 0 }; $taskListeners = [System.Net.NetworkInformation.IPGlobalProperties]::GetIPGlobalProperties().GetActiveTcpListeners(); if (@($taskListeners | Where-Object { $_.Port -eq 5055 }).Count -gt 0) { Write-Host 'Port 5055 is already in use; existing server left running.'; exit 0 }; & '.\ops\Start-DevelopmentWebsite.ps1'; exit $LASTEXITCODE } finally { if ($taskOwnsMutex) { $taskMutex.ReleaseMutex() }; $taskMutex.Dispose() }
